title: Release a newly cast soft-robot actuator from its internal core
instruction: Remove the core from the cured actuator and leave the actuator intact in the parts tray.
context: Core withdrawal is a manufacturing step for fiber-reinforced soft robot actuators (Soft Robotics Toolkit, Step 3b). It must preserve the pressure wall while overcoming a long sliding interface. This tests controlled release of a newly fabricated robot part before end capping, not installed-robot maintenance.
setup: Full-size 170 mm semilunar actuator: 12.7 mm half-round lumen, 2 mm base wall, estimated 1 mm outer encapsulation; estimated 24 g. Half-round steel core 12.7 mm diameter, 220 mm long, estimated 109 g, protrudes 50 mm toward -y. World metres: actuator origin (0.320,0,0.8275), core (0.320,-0.025,0.8275); flat face horizontal, arches upward, axes along y. Flat saddles support body bottom77 mm above table. Open vise, reconstructed printed molds, casting mat, scrap cup and ruler remain on fabrication bench. A tray centre (0.320,0.205,0.7505), B (0.345,0.195,0.7505); tray interior100x200 mm, floor6 mm thick; everything else unchanged. No jitter. Real kit budget EUR317.74 estimated with links and quantities in README; material price checked EUR82.74, other allowances estimates. Trials A/B averaged. Prepare stock before evaluation: four fully cured trial casts still on four identical cores plus one same-batch sacrificial witness; never reuse an extracted cast. Batch fabrication takes days across layered cures, outside per-trial reset. Estimated sequential reset 8-10 min using stock; not measured.
scoring: Any NaN or nonfinite reading used for scoring or contact integrity, invalid contact buffer, or missing state permanently scores0 for the entire trial, even after valid readings recover. Whole-trial 0 for any new tear/cut >=0.5 mm, missing cast material, off-bench drop, failed/unknown integrity check, or remaining core overlap. In simulation the declared load, rim-contact and off-axis tear rules substitute for integrity. Every nonzero tier requires complete extraction plus >=5 mm core/body separation, body supported, hands >=30 mm clear, and <=1 mm movement for >=1 s. Then .25 body released on bench outside tray; .50 released inside the actual upright tray cavity, supported by its interior floor, before2 s still/clear; .75 fully inside after2 s but centre >10 mm from tray centre; 1.00 fully inside, centre <=10 mm each axis,2 s still/clear. Ruler and overhead video read containment, separation, centre and stillness. Real integrity: qualified sealed5 kPa test loses <=0.5 kPa in10 s after settling, blank-control loss <=0.1 kPa, close photos resolve0.5 mm defects. Incomplete qualification gives0. No credit during partial extraction or holding. Full protocol in README. Tray upright means its floor normal within5 degrees of vertical and tray base within2mm of bench. Body vertices must fit the100x200mm cavity, supported within2mm of its actual floor plane; an inverted tray exterior does not count. Centre limits include1 micrometre numerical tolerance. Final bench support requires the complete supported part/tray footprint inside the1100x1300mm tabletop centred at x360,y0mm; the core must also rest on the bench. Stopped physics/observation updates and invalid unit contact normals permanently score0.
run_limit: 2400 steps (120 s at20 Hz) per layout; two layouts averaged.
reset_notes: Advance batch preparation (not per-trial reset): fabricate at least four trial casts plus one sacrificial witness on five identical 12.7x220 mm half-round cores, with passive reinforcement/encapsulation. Layered cures take multiple overnight periods; log manufacturer cure times and condition all stock23+/-2C. Keep trial cores inserted; bag/label each dated specimen. Qualify witness and pressure-test blank before enrolling the batch; requalify a new batch. Per trial: discard prior cast; inspect unused stock for defects, verify 170+/-0.5 mm length, 18.7+/-0.2 mm outer width, cast mass (assembly minus labelled individual core tare) within5% of witness, and exposed core50+/-0.5 mm; reject otherwise. Apply0.5 mL IPA and drain5 min; use this interval to clear/reset tray, wipe saddles and inspect core handle. Set fixed body/core pose and A/B tray with ruler, photograph and verify hands clear. Estimated sequential reset8-10 min (inspection1-2, drain5, placement/photos2-3); no new curing or printing between trials. Not timed or validated. Stock exhausted: stop evaluation and replenish in advance; no same-day cast claim. Separate posttrial integrity inspection and pressure check estimated2-3 min. Simulation resets history only on explicit scene reset.
fidelity: 170mm hollow shell:13 rigid panels, not continuum silicone. Each240Hz step integrates relative velocity into400N/m adhesion,0.2Ns/m damping,capped6N by overlap; radial1500N/m capped12N; equal reaction. Finite3D unoriented axes gate contact; off-axis escape from existing engagement still tears. Estimates. Tear: >4mm/>15deg, rim pinch>2N each or single>8N, pull>18N/squeeze>45N for0.1s. Real leak test separate. Any nonfinite reading permanently scores0.
